Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

params.vPool_: Vesper pool address where Synthetic token is defined as collateral.

Vesper pool address where Synthetic token is defined as collateral.

getKeepers().notice: List of keepers. Keeper can perform all authorized actions.

governor().notice: Governor of this contract is same as PoolRegistry governor. Governor can perform all authorized actions.

harvest(address,address).notice: Only 'authorized' role can call this function. It will calculate profit, withdraw profit from Vesper pool and transfer profit to governor.

isKeeper(address).notice: Returns whether given address is keeper or not.

mintAndDeposit(address,address,uint256).notice: Only 'authorized' role can call this function. It will mint `amount_` from `syntheticToken_` token and deposit those into `vPool_`.

sweep(address,uint256).notice: ERC20 recovery in case of stuck tokens due direct transfers to the contract address.

updateKeeper(address).notice: Only 'governor' role can call this function. This function will remove keeper_ if already exist in list else add in list.

updateVesperPool(address,address).notice: Only 'governor' role can call this function. This function will set a `vPool_` allowed to receive funds for a given synthetic asset

withdrawAndBurn(address,address,uint256).notice: Only 'authorized' role can call this function. It will calculate `_shares` from `amount_` and withdraw `_shares` from `vPool_` and burn amount of Synthetic token withdrawn from Vesper.

userdoc.notice: Operator will mint/burn SyntheticToken liquidity and deposit/withdraw to/from Vesper pool as needed.
